tasks.corrected_reference_answer: APIClient inherits requests.Session and adapts how HTTP reaches the daemon (docker/api/client.py:47-60). parse_host normalizes TCP endpoints to http/https and Unix endpoints to http+unix (docker/utils/utils.py:284-300). APIClient then mounts adapters for Unix sockets, Windows named pipes and SSH; ordinary HTTP/TLS remains supported (docker/api/client.py:143-190). Unix connections use AF_UNIX (docker/transport/unixconn.py:27-37), named-pipe connections use NpipeSocket (docker/transport/npipeconn.py:18-29), and SSH carries the HTTP connection through docker system dial-stdio (docker/transport/sshconn.py:102-121). The observed benefit is a common request interface over these transports, rather than replacing HTTP itself.

TensorflowBackend inherits NumpyBackend but overrides sampling with tf.random.categorical (src/qibo/backends/tensorflow.py:164-174,267-271). SHOT_BATCH_SIZE defaults to 2**18 (src/qibo/config.py:27-28). GlobalBackend selects and caches the default backend, and permits replacement (src/qibo/backends/__init__.py:41-85). CircuitResult delegates to that result's backend for shots or frequencies (src/qibo/states.py:113-116,183-194). These are common interfaces with backend-specific RNGs; they do not establish identical seeded outcomes across different backends.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: At the parser level, BigQuery MergeInsertClauseSegment adds a distinct Sequence("INSERT", "ROW") alternative. The other alternative parses INSERT with optional column-list and ValuesClauseSegment components (src/sqlfluff/dialects/dialect_bigquery.py:2680-2695). ANSI contains only that latter sequence (src/sqlfluff/dialects/dialect_ansi.py:3154-3164). OneOf selects the longest matching alternative, with first-match tie behavior (src/sqlfluff/core/parser/grammar/anyof.py:250-255; src/sqlfluff/core/parser/match_algorithms.py:140-151). Thus INSERT ROW can be recognized as a complete alternative rather than just INSERT. This grammar distinguishes syntactic forms; optional parser elements alone do not establish what a database does when VALUES is omitted.
